classification.difficultyReason: Each diagram directly supplies the four quadrilateral angles or right-angle markers; part a requires collecting two equal unknown angles and dividing the remaining angle total by two.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals in these diagrams, giving reasons.

spec.description: Unshaded quadrilateral PQRS with external vertex letters and internal angle labels. Ordinary source blue outlines become black.
spec.mathematics: Angles P and S are alpha; Q is 116 degrees and R is 108 degrees.

answer.worked:
The interior angles of quadrilateral $PQRS$ add to $360^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{aligned}2\alpha+116^{\circ}+108^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\2\alpha+224^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\2\alpha&=136^{\circ}\\\alpha&=68^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Unshaded quadrilateral ABCD with A below, B left, C above and D right; ordinary geometry is black.
spec.mathematics: Interior angles A=75 degrees, B=125 degrees, C=alpha and D=70 degrees.

answer.worked:
The interior angles of quadrilateral $ABCD$ add to $360^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{aligned}\alpha+75^{\circ}+125^{\circ}+70^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\\alpha+270^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\\alpha&=90^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Unshaded quadrilateral ABCD; no parallel markings. Ordinary geometry is black.
spec.mathematics: Interior angles A=72 degrees, B=115 degrees, C=alpha and D=63 degrees.

answer.worked:
The interior angles of quadrilateral $ABCD$ add to $360^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{aligned}\alpha+72^{\circ}+115^{\circ}+63^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\\alpha+250^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\\alpha&=110^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: PQ and SR vertical, PS horizontal and QR rising rightwards. Square right-angle markers at P and S. Ordinary geometry is black.
spec.mathematics: Angles P=S=90 degrees, Q=115 degrees and R=beta.

answer.worked:
The marked right angles are each $90^{\circ}$. The interior angles of quadrilateral $PQRS$ add to $360^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{aligned}\beta+90^{\circ}+115^{\circ}+90^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\\beta+295^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\\beta&=65^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Tilted unshaded quadrilateral ABCD with square right-angle markers at C and D. Ordinary geometry is black.
spec.mathematics: Angles A=alpha, B=118 degrees and C=D=90 degrees. Marker arms follow their incident edges.

answer.worked:
The marked right angles are each $90^{\circ}$. The interior angles of quadrilateral $ABCD$ add to $360^{\circ}$.

$$\begin{aligned}\alpha+118^{\circ}+90^{\circ}+90^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\\alpha+298^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\\alpha&=62^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$
